programme.title: Dayaalu
programme.desc: A young boy gets orphaned after his parents die in a car accident. Years later, he meets two college students who are the reincarnation of his parents.

programme.title: Mirza Ghalib
programme.desc: Mirza Ghalib, a poet, feels unappreciated when his poetry goes unrecognised in the royal court. His life changes when he meets Chaudhvin, who is in awe of his poetry and falls in love with her.

programme.title: Bhoot Returns
programme.desc: Tarun and Namrata move into a luxurious bungalow with Taman and Nimmi, their son and daughter respectively. However, strange occurrences start taking place and they must escape in order to survive.

programme.title: Jabariya Jodi
programme.desc: Abhay, a righteous thug, forcefully kidnaps grooms who demand dowry and later marries them off. Babli, his childhood sweetheart, re-enters his life and changes his priorities.

programme.title: Loveyatri
programme.desc: Sushrut who runs a Garba academy falls in love with a beautiful NRI, Michelle, but her father creates a rift between the two. However, Sushrut is determined to win her back.

programme.title: Uri: The Surgical Strike
programme.desc: Major Vihaan Singh Shergill of the Indian Army leads a covert operation against a group of militants who attacked a base in Uri, Kashmir, in 2016 and killed many soldiers.

programme.title: Kaho Naa... Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: After the untimely death of her lover, Sonia sinks into depression. She soon moves abroad for a fresh start, unaware of the twisted fate that awaits her.

programme.title: Jawan
programme.desc: Driven by a personal vendetta, a man sets out to rectify the wrongs in the society to keep a promise made years ago.

programme.title: Geetha Govindam
programme.desc: Vijay Govind, a young lecturer in a college, wishes to get married at the earliest. He tries to woo Geetha, an independent and a level-headed woman, who is not easy to convince.

programme.title: Koogle Kuttappa
programme.desc: A conservative villager hates the idea of his son relocating to Russia for a job. However, when his son brings a robot to care for him, he develops an unlikely bond with the machine.

programme.title: Go Goa Gone
programme.desc: Things take a dangerous turn when the aftermath of a rave party causes three friends to get stranded on an isolated island infested with zombies.

programme.title: 3G - A Killer Connection
programme.desc: A couple's vacation turns into a nightmare after they are harassed by a stranger.

programme.title: Apaharan
programme.desc: Ajay, an aspiring policeman, borrows money from a moneylender to pursue his dream. However, he is unable to repay the loan on time and decides to be a part of a kidnapping scheme.

programme.title: Good Newwz
programme.desc: Two married couples are unsuccessful in conceiving and seek medical treatment. However, they end up in a complicated situation after their doctor makes a blunder.

programme.title: Sky Force
programme.desc: Brave heroes embark on a quest for truth as India and Pakistan enter an airstrike war that threatens to pose deadly consequences.

programme.title: Judaai
programme.desc: Shashikant and Gauri get married in honour of his late father's will. But, marital problems soon arise when Gauri suspects him of having an affair, leading to a chain of misunderstandings.

programme.title: Singham Again
programme.desc: Police officer Bajirao Singham and his competent colleagues must join hands and combine their efforts in order to save Bajirao's wife.

programme.title: Bhoot Bangla
programme.desc: After inheriting a cursed ancestral palace in Mangalpur, Arjun hosts his sister Meera's wedding there. The decision unleashes a violent supernatural force tied to their family history.

programme.title: Deva
programme.desc: A police officer investigates the murder of his close friend. However, he suffers a traumatic accident that wipes away his memory, jeopardising the investigation.

programme.desc: After being harassed by his family members, a retired teacher decides to teach them a lesson in order to discipline them.

programme.title: Love Story

programme.title: Maayakumari
programme.desc: A moviemaker sets out to make a biographical movie on Mayakumari, the legendary actress, and tries to find out the reasons that caused her disappearance.

programme.title: Gotro

programme.title: Drishtikone
programme.desc: Srimoti, a widow, suspects there is more to her husband's mysterious death. Thereafter, she hires a married lawyer, Jion, who eventually gets attracted to Srimoti, to investigate the matter.

programme.title: The Happy Pill
programme.desc: After getting expelled from medical school, Siddhartha works at a sweet shop while taking care of his depressed mother. But, chaos ensues when he claims to have concocted a pill to cure depression.

programme.desc: Latika is forcefully married off after Bilash leaves the country. When he returns and finds that she has a family, he decides to avenge all the wrongs done to him.

programme.title: Tirandaj Shabor

programme.title: Hero

programme.title: Shesh Bichar
programme.desc: After Rajiv and Subhra marry, their new life faces turmoil. Subhra's former lover, Raja, returns with the intention of wrecking their lives, creating unexpected challenges for the couple.

programme.title: Swamir Ghar
programme.desc: Ajay, struggling in his life, finds his troubles worsening when he falls in love with Sangita, a woman from a wealthy family and a vastly different social background.

programme.title: Sagardwipey Jawker Dhan
programme.desc: Two researchers and a doctor set out to find a mythical substance called red mercury to solve the fossil fuel crisis and save a child's life.

programme.title: Bagha Jatin
programme.desc: Jatindranath Mukherjee plays a central role in the revolutionary struggle against colonial rule. He is revered for his leadership and dedication in India's quest for freedom.

programme.title: Byomkesh Pawrbo
programme.desc: Byomkesh Bakshi, a detective, is hired to find the arms left by the American soldiers after World War II. However, his search leads to the discovery of a bigger conspiracy.

programme.title: Magic
programme.desc: Finding solace in magic, Indra keeps his problems at bay. However, his life takes a turn when he meets Kirti and their connection unveils a past life story.

programme.title: Rawkto Rawhoshyo
programme.desc: Swarnaja, a radio jockey, offers to be a surrogate for a couple. But years later, when she is on a quest to find her son, she discovers a child-trafficking racket run by the same couple.
